Notice Regarding California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Determinations. Pursuant to CEQA, a "project" is defined as a "whole action" subject to a public agency's discretionary funding or approval that has the potential to either (1) cause a direct physical change in the environment or (2) cause a reasonably foreseeable indirect physical change in the environment. "Projects" include discretionary activity by a public agency, a private activity that receives any public funding, or activities that involve the public agency's issuance of a discretionary approval and is not statutorily or categorically exempt from CEQA. (Pub. Res. Code § 21065.) To the extent that matters listed in this Agenda are considered “projects” under CEQA, their appropriate CEQA determination will be listed below each recommendation. If no CEQA determination is listed, it has been determined that the action does not constitute a “project” under CEQA.

1.
Consideration of Water Capacity, Water System Development, and Water System Annexation Fees Pursuant to the Development Impact Fee Nexus Study Prepared by Willdan, Conduct Public Hearing, and Consideration of Resolution No. 2025-UB-07. Recommendations: 1) Receive the proposed Water System Development Impact Fee Nexus Study from Wildan Financial Services; and 2) Open the Public Hearing for the adoption of updated and new Water Capacity, Water System Development and Water System Annexation fees; receive public comments, close the Public Hearing; and 3) Approve and adopt Resolution No. 2025-UB-07, regarding the Water Capacity, Water System Development, and Water System Annexation Fees, to be effective 60 days after adoption.
D-1.1. Adoption of Water Capacity, WSD, and Water Annexation Fees_Willdan Nexus Study
D-1.2. Resolution UB-2025-07
D-1.3. Development Impact Fee Nexus Study by Willdan
2.
Consideration of a Professional Services Agreement to Stetson Engineers Inc to Prepare a Pipeline Assessment Study and Replacement Plan for a Not-to-exceed Cost of $88,000.00. Recommendations: 1) Approve the Award of Contract to Stetson Engineers Inc. for preparing a pipeline assessment study and replacement plan in an amount not-to-exceed $ 88,000; and 2) Authorize the issuance of a Purchase Order for a not-to-exceed price of $ 88,000 in accordance with Azusa Municipal Code Sec 2-518 - Contracts; and 3) Authorize the Chairperson to execute the Contract, in a form acceptable to the Board's General Counsel.
D-2.1. Award PSA for Pipeline Assessment Study and Replacement Plan
D-2.2. Professional Services Agreement with Stetson Engineers Inc

CONSENT CALENDAR
The Consent Calendar adopting the printed recommended actions will be enacted with one vote. If Councilmembers or Staff wish to address any item on the Consent Calendar
individually, it will be considered under SPECIAL CALL ITEMS.
1.
Minutes of the Utility Board Meeting on: May 27, 2025, and June 27, 2025. Recommendations: 1) Approve Minutes as written.
E-1.1. 5-27-2025 Utility Board Minutes_Draft

2.
Consideration of Purchase of Two 2025 Ford F-150 EV Trucks for Electric Operations for a Not-to-exceed amount of $141,402.58. Recommendations: 1) Waive the competitive purchase requirements pursuant to Section 2-521(a), Article VII, Chapter 2 of the Azusa Municipal Code (Cooperative and Piggyback Purchasing); and 2) Approve the purchase of two (2) new 2025 Ford F-150 Electric Pickup Trucks; and 3) Authorize the issuance of a Purchase Order to National Auto Fleet Group in the amount not-to-exceed
$ 141,402.58.
E-2.1. Purchase of Two EV Ford Lightning F-150 for Electric Operations
E-2.2. Sourcewell Quote ID 30689 R1
3.
Consideration of Professional Services Agreement with WaterWise Consulting Inc. for Irrigation Efficiency Retrofit Program & Landscape Survey for Commercial Customers for Three Years for a Total Cost of $90,000.00. Recommendations: 1) Approve a Professional Services Agreement with WaterWise Consulting, Inc. to provide irrigation efficiency retrofits to ALW customers for three years, with two optional one-year extensions, for a total cost of $90,000 or $30,000 per fiscal year pursuant to AMC Sections 2-520(b) ("Sole Source Purchase") and 2-521(a) ("Cooperative and Piggyback Purchasing"); and 2) Authorize the issuance of a Purchase Order to WaterWise for a total of $90,000; and 3) Authorize the Chairperson to execute the Professional Services Agreement in a form acceptable to the Board's General Counsel.
E-3.1. PSA WaterWise Consulting for Irrigation Controller Rebate Program
E-3.2. PSA WaterWise Consulting
E-3.3. WaterWise Consulting Proposal
4.
Consideration of a Three-Year Resource Adequacy Power Generation Purchase Agreement with the City of Vernon for a Per Month Cost of $123,750.00. Recommendations: 1) Approve the purchase of 15 megawatts of resource adequacy power generation capacity from City of Vernon for a period of three years at a cost of $123,750/month; and 2) Authorize the issuance of a Blanket Purchase Order to the City of Vernon for FY26-27, FY27-28, and FY28-29; and Authorize the General Manager to execute the Confirmation Agreement.
